name: full_name
description: Complete name of the person or company formatted in lowercase and first capital letter

name: email
description: Email address of the person or company

name: type
description: Type of the person or company

name: cpf
description: Only fill if natural person. Brazilian individual taxpayer registry (CPF) formatted with dots and dash

name: rg
description: Only fill if natural person. Brazilian general registry (RG) number

name: cnpj
description: Only fill if company. Brazilian national registry (CNPJ) number

name: date_of_birth_or_establishment
description: Birth date or establishment date in month/day/year format of the person or company

name: profession
description: Current job title, profession or purpose of the person or company

name: marital_status
description: Only fill if natural person. Current marital status.

name: postal_code
description: Postal or ZIP code of the person or company

name: state
description: Brazilian state of the person or company

name: city
description: Brazilian city name of the person or company

name: address
description: Street address with house/apartment/room number of the person or company

name: phone_primary
description: Primary contact phone number of the person or company

name: phone_secondary
description: Alternative phone number (optional) of the person or company

name: gender
description: Only fill if natural person. Gender selection of the person

name: age
description: User age or time since establishment of the person or company

name: requests
description: Final requests

name: lawsuit_amount
description: Lawsuit amount in USD

name: signature_date
description: Date document was signed

name: signature_time
description: Time document was signed, if available

name: notes
description: Additional information or special requests of the person or company
